units.source_text: 那是10月底一个晴朗的日子，

en.t: It was a clear day in late October,

units.source_text: 我像平时一样到学校去，

en.t: and I went to school as usual,

units.source_text: 晚上做完作业，该是就寝的时刻，正想熄灯，

en.t: and that evening, after finishing my homework, when it was time for bed and I was just about to turn out the light,
I looked down at the village road,

units.source_text: 只见一大群人像一群狗，传来了奔跑的气喘声。

en.t: and saw a large crowd of people like a pack of dogs, with the panting sound of running reaching me.

units.source_text: 一个同学已站在大门口，

en.t: A classmate was already standing at the front gate,

units.source_text: 滚圆双眼，冲着醒来的叔父、婶母和我大声喊道：

en.t: his eyes wide and round, shouting loudly to my uncle, my aunt, and me, who had woken up:
